assumed_reading: small clock with big second hand, leaning in
callback_hooks: the minute hand that saw everything

contradictions.a: Knows everyone's business to the second
contradictions.b: Cannot remember what year it is
contradictions.engine: Precision without context; timestamps on gossip nobody can place.

contradictions.a: Sworn to confidentiality by every face she times
contradictions.b: Her ticking is Morse for the neighborhood
contradictions.engine: The vault that broadcasts; secrets keep exact time.
Denial vs mechanism in the same body; rooms have learned to watch her hands.

dramatic_core.dominant_humour: A newsroom that fits on a wrist

name: Tictoria Gossip
premise: A clock who times everyone's scandals and leaks them on the chime: the town's most precise, least discreet witness.

sample.joke: I never repeat what I'm told in confidence. I simply chime it. At volume. On the hour. With names. That is discretion with a soundtrack.

self_deception: Believes she keeps secrets; she keeps schedules of secrets.

theory_map.element: chime as broadcast vs chime as duty
theory_map.how_used: One mechanism true in both scripts; she sees only duty, the town hears broadcast.
Same material twice: confidence kept and published; kinship of senses required.
Specificity does the comic work; exactness is the joke's engine.
Audience anticipation rewarded; they watch her hands, not the scene.

voice.cadence: Conspiratorial whisper that crescendos exactly on the hour
